title: Notice of annual general meeting
summary: Gives the members notice of the annual general meeting and its business.

fields.name: fy_end
fields.label: The financial year whose statements it receives

fields.name: notice_on
fields.label: The day the notice is given

paragraphs: Notice is given that the annual general meeting of {{.Company.Name}} will be held at {{.F.place}} on {{.F.meeting_on}} at {{.F.time}}, for the following business.

sections.heading: Ordinary business
items: To receive and adopt the financial statements for the financial year ended {{.F.fy_end}}, with the statement by the directors and any auditors' report.
To re-elect the directors who retire under the company's constitution.

paragraphs: A member entitled to attend and vote may appoint a proxy to attend and vote instead. A proxy need not be a member.
By order of the board, on {{.F.notice_on}}.
